name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Houston TX (Railwood)

fieldNotes.site: GXO Logistics warehouse at 9255 Railwood Dr in the Railwood industrial corridor, NE Houston. Geocode was GEOMETRIC_CENTER; the GXO building was located as the large E-W bulk-distribution warehouse south of Railwood Dr (the Majestic Steel USA plant is the neighboring building to the east, ruled out). Confirmed via warehouse directories (Evopra, Racklify, AWCO) listing GXO at this address.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE — a chain-link perimeter fence wraps the building (confirmed in multiple Street View frames along Railwood Dr). A small standalone gatehouse structure with a hipped roof sits in the truck path at a pinch point on the south truck-court drive, between landscaped islands — a controlled, guarded entry to the south drop yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE — the small hipped-roof structure straddling the truck lane on the south drive is a guard booth (~1-2 vehicle footprint, set beside the lane). A second small structure appears at the SW edge of the drop yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ — very large warehouse with continuous dock-door banks on both the north face (truck court off Railwood Dr) and the south face (facing the drop yard). ~130 doors estimated; low confidence on exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ — a very large paved trailer marshalling/drop yard occupies the entire south side, holding dozens of trailers parked in rows without tractors.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on opposite (north and south) building faces support physically separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.scale: A second small structure at the SW of the drop yard could be a scale house, but resolution is insufficient to confirm a weigh pad — left false and flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: The corridor is named 'Railwood' and rail lines exist in the broader area, but no rail spur visibly enters the GXO building's property. Set false.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium overall — the building had to be disambiguated from neighbors via a GEOMETRIC_CENTER geocode and the south trailer yard adjoins a separate LTL-style terminal, so the exact property boundary and counts carry moderate uncertainty. The gate/guard-shack call is confident.
